title: Belgian and European farmers plan protest in Brussels European quarter

tea.why: Protesters oppose proposed cuts to the Common Agricultural Policy in the EU budget for 2028-2034.
tea.want: Farmers demand the protection of agricultural funding against planned reductions.
tea.changed: Nov 24: Sources reported that farmers plan to demonstrate in the European quarter on Thursday.

summary: Farmers from Belgium and other European countries, including Hungarian producers, have scheduled a protest in the European quarter of Brussels. The demonstration is organized by COPA-COGECA, representing millions of producers and cooperatives, alongside regional groups such as the Walloon Agricultural Federation and the Flemish Farmers' Union, with participation from the Hungarian Farmers' Union. The action is called in response to the European Council president's proposed 2028–2034 budget framework, which reportedly reduces Common Agricultural Policy funding by approximately 15 percent. European Union leaders are set to discuss these budget measures during a summit in Brussels.
demands: Stop the proposed 15 percent reduction in agricultural funding
Protect the Common Agricultural Policy budget from reallocation
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Media reports confirmed that farmers are scheduled to demonstrate in the European quarter on Thursday.
